text:
Maya P: quick sync on SI handoffs — want to lock down rules of engagement for claim/stitching. proposal: SI can claim leads when there's an assigned SI POC or a co-sell tag; otherwise route to intake. thoughts?
Samir K: clarifying q — what about existing opps where AE already engaged? do we force a handoff?
Maya P: good q. my thinking: if AE is actively engaged (last activity <30d) and opp > $50k, AE keeps. otherwise SI can claim.
Jia L: +1. here's a compact mapping we can implement in orchestration:
```
account.co_sell == true            -> owner = SI_team
account.sales_engaged == true && opp.value >= 50000 -> owner = Sales_AE
else                              -> owner = Intake_queue
```
Also add tag: claim_ttl_hours = 24 to prevent double-claims. automation can create a claim-task in JIRA when SI claims.
Leo V: 2 quick ops asks: 1) simultaneous claims — enforce a first-claim wins with TTL and notify previous claimant; 2) can we auto-attach partner contract/NDA check to claim flow?
Jia L: both feasible. we can add a small webhook step: on claim -> check contract_store for NDA flag; if missing, set claim status = pending and ping partner-success.
partnerships-bot: created doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PRT/pages/si-handshake-stitching (draft) — added mapping table + claim lifecycle diagram.
Maya P: thanks — scheduling 30m tomorrow 10:00 PT to finalize. action items: implement mapping rules in staging, add claim_ttl = 24h, add NDA check step, and create a JIRA template for claim tasks. :thumbsup:
Samir K: noted, will prep a few edge-case examples (global accounts, marketplace deals).
Leo V: i can take the JIRA template + notification flow.
Jia L: i'll drop a PR for the mapping logic and quick tests by EOD today.
Maya P: great — we'll review in the call.
